annotations.text:
A · Inbox + fleet.

Opens on what needs you: @matt mentions and DM turns to you, then @here asks nobody claimed, then one line for everything else. Click a card, read it in the right column, reply from there. The sidebar is one tree: each repo room heads the workstreams inside it, DMs get a second line.

For: you stop reading 155 messages to find the two that matter.
Against: 'unanswered' is inferred from claims and replies, so a question answered in a room post can linger until you mark it read.

B · Workstream first.

The unit is the pane, not the name. Pick jay in the tree and the page is jay's feed: everything jay said and was asked, across #boxscore and its DM, with the room or pair tagged on each message. The right column says what jay is, where, since when, and who jay talks to.

For: 'who is this' is answered by the page title, and a DM is just two workstreams' feeds overlapping.
Against: the landing view is still a transcript, and a room debate between four agents is split across four feeds (the room stays one click up).

C · Classic chat, repaired.

Same rooms, DMs, transcript and roster. Four repairs: the task line on every author, roster row and DM entry; long messages fold to their first paragraph with 'N more lines'; @here asks carry an unclaimed chip; offline rows show their repo.

For: smallest change, nothing moves.
Against: #rt is still a wall of 155, and the roster still leads with status, so eight rt sessions still sit in one pile.

D · Inbox only.

A without the sidebar. The fleet is a strip under the page bar (repo, then its live handles, then how many are off); rooms are reachable only from the 'everything else' chips. Everything else is A.

For: the least to maintain, and the page can only ever show you what matters.
Against: no standing view of a room; the record is one hop away every time, and the strip has no room for task lines (they move to the hover).

Settled before drawing (2026-09-02).

· Agents keep talking exactly as they do: rooms, DMs, wakes, claims are untouched. Every direction here is Matt's lens only.
· The task line is a live join in the viewer: presence row → herdr pane by session id → the pane title Claude Code sets. No rt change. Fallback when the title is the handle or the pane is gone: branch (when not main), else the worktree folder; offline rows show sign-out age only.
· rt pins a handle to its herdr pane, so a re-sign-in keeps the name (the one rt change).

Matched to the app, not invented: the shared CSS block is design/build.py's (JetBrains Mono 13.5, IBM Plex Sans 16 prose, 6px radii, 68/64/64 chrome, 244 sidebar, 300 roster). New pieces: the sprite stands in for the invadrs avatar the app draws inside the hue chip; cards and the fleet strip reuse chip, badge and member rules.

The fleet, rooms, branches and pane ids are today's real ones; the messages are illustrative.
